subject: SIG questionnaire — evidence taxonomy and on-prem sample packet request
messages:
From: Claire Morales <procurement@helixtech.com>
To: irene_choi@redwoodinference.com
Cc: J. Peters <security-ops@helixtech.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: HelixTech RFP: SIG questionnaire scope and on-prem sample packet

Hi Irene,

Thanks for the quick onboarding call this morning. As we prepare HelixTech's vendor package for our board review, can you confirm the following:

1) Will Redwood provide a completed SIG questionnaire (standard format) mapped to your internal control owners and evidence references? We need the mapping rather than a flat questionnaire.
2) We're requesting a sanitized on-prem sample packet showing how Redwood would package telemetry, KMS key provenance, and deployment manifests when deployed in a customer VPC/on-prem. It must be fully redacted for any customer-specific data.
3) For SOC 2 / ISO artifacts, please indicate the latest Type 2 period date and whether you can provide redacted copies of the reports and scope map.

Target timeline: our board packet deadline is Monday 2026-06-22. Ideally we receive the SIG mapping and a sample packet by 2026-06-15 so our security team has time to review.

Appreciate your help — feel free to call if anything is unclear.

Claire Morales
Senior Procurement Manager
HelixTech
procurement@helixtech.com
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Claire Morales <procurement@helixtech.com>
Cc: J. Peters <security-ops@helixtech.com>, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 10:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: HelixTech RFP: SIG questionnaire scope and on-prem sample packet

Hi Claire — thanks for the clear ask and timeline. We're happy to support. Quick confirmation of scope and next steps below:

- SIG mapping: we will deliver a completed SIG spreadsheet that includes our control ID, control owner, implementation evidence references (drive link/file names), and remediation status where applicable.
- On‑prem sample packet: we can assemble a sanitized sample bundle that demonstrates the artifact types your security team requested (telemetry snippets, KMS proof-of-rotation manifests, deployment manifest). It will be explicitly redacted and synthetic where needed.
- SOC 2 / ISO: our latest SOC 2 Type 2 report covers the period 2025-03-01 to 2026-02-28. We can provide a redacted PDF of the report and the ISO 27001 scope map.

Proposed delivery: preliminary SIG mapping + artifact index by 2026-06-15, final sanitized packet and redacted reports by 2026-06-18. If that works for HelixTech's board packet review cadence we will proceed.

I'll loop in Marissa (assurance lead) and Karthik (security operations) to prepare the artifact list and apply redaction guidelines.

Best,
Irene Choi
Head of Customer Assurance
Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwoodinference.com
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 10:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: HelixTech RFP: SIG questionnaire scope and on-prem sample packet

Team — forwarding HelixTech's request. Please:

- Marissa: assemble the SIG mapping spreadsheet and identify the canonical evidence files we can share (redacted). Label each evidence item with the control it supports.
- Karthik: produce a sanitized on-prem sample packet (tar gz stub) that contains: a redacted deployment-manifest, synthetic telemetry snippets (no PII), a KMS rotation proof file demonstrating key metadata but not actual keys, and a brief README describing redaction steps.

Priority: HelixTech needs a reviewable SIG mapping by 2026-06-15. If anything will slip, flag K for escalation and we will request an extension immediately.

Thanks,
Irene

Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 08:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: HelixTech RFP: SIG questionnaire scope and on-prem sample packet

Irene/Marissa —

I've started the packet build. Items we can include and recommended redaction approach:

- SOC2_Type2_2025_Report.pdf (redact customer names in test samples and service descriptions; keep auditor opinion intact)
- ISO27001_Scope_Map.pdf (sanitized network diagrams removed; scope statements OK)
- SIG_Completed_Template.xlsx (mapping sheet with Control ID, Owner, Evidence file ref)
- onprem-sample-packet-sanitized.tar.gz (contains: deployment-manifest-redacted.txt, kms-rotation-metadata.csv (no key material), telemetry-snippets.json (synthetic), README-redaction.md)
- deployment-manifest-redacted.txt (remove resource identifiers and replace with placeholders)

Notes: The on-prem packet will be a sanitized stub; for board review it should demonstrate our packaging/process rather than operational artifacts. I'm pulling the rotation metadata and will ensure no secrets appear.

Timeline: I can deliver the SIG mapping and evidence index by 2026-06-15 EOD; the sanitized sample packet will be ready by 2026-06-17. If HelixTech strictly needs the packet earlier, we can compress work into a same-week sprint but will need an extra engineering reviewer.

-Karthik
Security Operations Lead
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Claire Morales <procurement@helixtech.com>, irene_choi@redwoodinference.com, karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: SIG mapping and artifact index — HelixTech (preliminary)

Claire — attaching the initial deliverables per Irene's plan. See attachment list below and quick notes:

Attachments (attached to this email as stubs):
- SIG_Completed_Template.xlsx — includes control owner and evidence file pointers (column F has Drive links).
- SOC2_Type2_2025_Report.pdf (redacted) — audited opinion and test summary retained.
- ISO27001_Scope_Map.pdf — scope and boundary definitions.
- Evidence_Index.csv — short index of all files and the control IDs they map to.

Redaction notes: we replaced tenant and project IDs with placeholders, removed customer-specific log samples, and replaced exact IAM principals with role names. Karthik and I validated the sanitized telemetry snippets to ensure no PII.

Drive folder (read-only): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C-example-helix-evidence

Next: Karthik will drop the sanitized packet tar and the manifest by EOD 2026-06-17 as discussed. Please confirm receipt and if you'd like any additional annotations on the SIG mapping.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Assurance Program Manager
Redwood Inference

Claire / J. —

We're sending the initial packet for HelixTech's review. Summary below plus links/attachments: 

- SIG mapping: attached (SIG_Completed_Template.xlsx). Column G contains the canonical evidence file name and the Drive link.
- SOC 2 Type 2: attached redacted PDF (report period 2025-03-01 to 2026-02-28).
- ISO 27001 scope map: attached.
- On‑prem sample packet: staged in Drive as a sanitized tar.gz stub (onprem-sample-packet-sanitized.tar.gz). It includes deployment-manifest-redacted.txt and kms-rotation-metadata.csv (no key material).

Requests / next steps from HelixTech security: please let us know if you'd like an annotated walkthrough of the SIG mapping or a short 30-minute call to review the on‑prem packet contents. If you require additional redaction or a more detailed telemetry sample, we can provide a scoped addendum — that will require an approval ticket to pull production traces.

If everything looks good, we'll also prepare a brief attestation letter that summarizes what was redacted and why (useful for procurement/legal to include in your board packet). Draft attestation can be ready by 2026-06-18.

Best regards,
Irene Choi
Head of Customer Assurance
Redwood Inference
